correctness.rationale: For fixed α>−1 and standard L_n^(α)(0)=binom(n+α,n), the primitive F= x^(α+1)e^(−x)L_(n−1)^(α+1)/n satisfies F′=x^α e^(−x)L_n^(α) and F″+(1−α/x)F′+(n/x)F=0. Stieltjes integration by parts gives the exact BV norm sup|F|, attained by a single Heaviside jump. The exact Sonin derivative d/dx(F²+x F′²/n)=(2α+1−2x)F′²/n puts the global maximum at first zero for −1<α≤−1/2, otherwise at nearest zeros bracketing x*=α+1/2. Mehler–Heine scaling of first root gives n M→(j_(α,1)/2)^(α+1)|J_(α+1)(j_(α,1))| in edge regime; compact-uniform Plancherel–Rotach oscillations with local zero spacing O(n^(−1/2)) give bulk M~n^(α/2−3/4)e^(−x*/2)(x*)^(α/2+1/4)/√π. α=−1/2 matches 1/√π. Independently recomputed root extremizers at n=9 for α=−.8,−.5,0,1; these bounded checks do not establish classical asymptotic uniformity.
